protocol.calibration: Full public domain; future availability exclusively scorer mask
protocol.weights: Frozen source checkpoints chosen previously by per-cell cal Brier; no refit or new training seed
protocol.selection: Best calibration IoU, ties lower alpha then tree; seal both timing orders before assessment load
protocol.assessment: Already inspected public TRAIN periods and same event origins; not final

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights

limitations: Only frozen checkpoints, one fit seed, old public TRAIN noisy proxy events. No latent labels or new formal score. Existing sampler selects observation-positive horizons, so optional nonempty can still overfit sampling. Both timing choices retain original cal seals.
